'''Lorenzo Pareschi''' is an Italian mathematician working in [[numerical analysis]], [[applied mathematics]], [[kinetic theory]], and multiscale computational methods. He is Chair of Applied and Computational Mathematics at [[Heriot-Watt University]] and professor of numerical analysis at the [[University of Ferrara]].<ref name="auto">{{cite web |url=https://researchportal.hw.ac.uk/en/persons/lorenzo-pareschi/ |title=Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=Heriot-Watt Research Portal |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hw.ac.uk/profiles/uk/school/macs/faculty/lorenzo-pareschi |title=Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=Heriot-Watt University |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://docente.unife.it/lorenzo.pareschi |title=Pareschi Lorenzo |publisher=University of Ferrara |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>

== Career and research ==
Pareschi received his PhD in mathematics in 1996 from the [[University of Bologna]]. He has held visiting and research appointments at institutions including the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], [[Georgia Institute of Technology]], [[Université d'Orléans]], [[Université Paul Sabatier]], and the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences at [[New York University]].<ref name="auto1">{{cite web |url=https://docente.unife.it/docenti-en/lorenzo.pareschi/curriculum |title=Curriculum - Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=University of Ferrara |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>

His research concerns numerical methods for [[Kinetic theory of gases|kinetic equations]], [[explicit and implicit methods|implicit-explicit methods]] for [[partial differential equations]], [[uncertainty quantification]], structure-preserving methods, and mathematical models of [[collective behaviour]].<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8706-6939 |title=Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=ORCID |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>
He is particularly known for work on the numerical analysis of the [[Boltzmann equation]] and related kinetic models, including fast [[spectral methods]] for the computation of the Boltzmann collision operator,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Mouhot |first1=Clément |last2=Pareschi |first2=Lorenzo |title=Fast algorithms for computing the Boltzmann collision operator |journal=Mathematics of Computation |volume=75 |issue=256 |year=2006 |pages=1833-1852 |doi=10.1090/S0025-5718-06-01874-6|arxiv=math/0607542 }}</ref> and
for contributions to implicit-explicit [[Runge-Kutta methods]] for multiscale [[Hyperbolic partial differential equation|hyperbolic systems]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Pareschi |first1=Lorenzo |last2=Russo |first2=Giovanni |title=Implicit-Explicit Runge-Kutta schemes for multiscale applications to hyperbolic systems with relaxation |journal=Journal of Scientific Computing |volume=25 |issue=1-2 |year=2005 |pages=129-155 |doi=10.1007/s10915-004-4636-4}}</ref>

His later work has also included [[optimisation]], [[control]], [[machine learning]], [[social dynamics]], and [[Mathematical modelling of infectious diseases|epidemic modelling]].<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://maddmaths.simai.eu/persone/intervista-con-lorenzo-pareschi/ |title=Intervista con Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=MaddMaths! |date=11 December 2021 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>

== Publications ==
Pareschi is the author or co-author of research monographs and advanced texts in numerical analysis and kinetic theory. With Giuseppe Toscani, he co-authored ''Interacting Multiagent Systems: Kinetic Equations and Monte Carlo Methods'', published by [[Oxford University Press]] in 2013.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Pareschi |first1=Lorenzo |last2=Toscani |first2=Giuseppe |title=Interacting Multiagent Systems: Kinetic Equations and Monte Carlo Methods |publisher=Oxford University Press |year=2013 |url=https://global.oup.com/academic/product/interacting-multiagent-systems-9780199655465}}</ref> In 2024 he co-authored ''Implicit-Explicit Methods for Evolutionary Partial Differential Equations'' with Sebastiano Boscarino and Giovanni Russo, published by [[SIAM]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Boscarino |first1=Sebastiano |last2=Pareschi |first2=Lorenzo |last3=Russo |first3=Giovanni |title=Implicit-Explicit Methods for Evolutionary Partial Differential Equations |publisher=SIAM |year=2024 |url=https://epubs.siam.org/doi/book/10.1137/1.9781611978209}}</ref>

Among his most cited survey works is the article ''Numerical Methods for Kinetic Equations'', published in ''[[Acta Numerica]]'' in 2014.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Dimarco |first1=Giacomo |last2=Pareschi |first2=Lorenzo |title=Numerical Methods for Kinetic Equations |journal=Acta Numerica |volume=23 |year=2014 |pages=369-520 |doi=10.1017/S0962492914000063}}</ref>

== Editorial work ==
Pareschi has served on the editorial boards of several journals in applied and computational mathematics.<ref name="auto1"/> In 2025 the Maxwell Institute announced his appointment as the next Editor-in-Chief of ''[[Multiscale Modeling & Simulation]]'', with effect from January 2026, and SIAM lists him as Editor-in-Chief for the journal's 2026 volume.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.maxwell.ac.uk/2025/09/10/lorenzeo-pareschi-appointed-next-editor-in-chief-of-siam-multiscale-modeling-and-simulation/ |title=Lorenzo Pareschi appointed next Editor-in-Chief of SIAM Multiscale Modeling and Simulation |publisher=The Maxwell Institute |date=10 September 2025 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://epubs.siam.org/journals/smjmap/about |title=Multiscale Modeling & Simulation - About the Journal |publisher=SIAM |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
Among his distinctions are the Nelder Visiting Fellowship at [[Imperial College London]] in 2015, the John von Neumann Professorship at the [[Technical University of Munich]] in 2019, and a [[Royal Society Wolfson Fellowship]] awarded in 2023.
<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/mathematics/research/opportunities/nelder-visiting-fellowships/fellows/professor-lorenzo-pareschi/ |title=Professor Lorenzo Pareschi |publisher=Imperial College London |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1clEpE575G_vQRH-aUuj_rEoxZm963AP3/view |title=Curriculum vitae - Lorenzo Pareschi |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://royalsociety.org/news/2023/06/wolfson-2023/ |title=Royal Society announces research leaders awarded Royal Society Wolfson Fellowships and Royal Society Wolfson Visiting Fellowships 2023 |publisher=The Royal Society |date=7 June 2023 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>

In 2025 he was awarded an Advanced Grant from the Italian Science Fund of [[Ministry of Education, University and Research|MUR]] for the ADAMUS project, devoted to advanced numerical methods for multiscale systems with uncertainty.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.maxwell.ac.uk/2025/03/31/lorenzo-pareschi-receives-e2-million-funding-to-help-predict-the-unexpected/ |title=Lorenzo Pareschi receives €2 million funding to help predict the unexpected |publisher=The Maxwell Institute |date=31 March 2025 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hw.ac.uk/news/2025/italian-scientist-receives-2-million-funding-to-help-predict-the-unexpected |title=Italian scientist receives €2 million funding to help predict the unexpected |publisher=Heriot-Watt University |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lanuovaferrara.it/ferrara/cronaca/2025/03/19/news/la-matematica-domina-il-mondo-la-ricerca-di-unife-anti-fake-news-1.100678326 |title=La matematica domina il mondo: la ricerca di Unife anti fake news |publisher=La Nuova Ferrara |date=19 March 2025 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.estense.com/2025/1120804/algoritmi-e-complessita-al-progetto-adamus-di-unife-due-milioni-dal-fis/ |title=Algoritmi e complessità, al progetto ADAMUS di Unife due milioni dal FIS |publisher=Estense.com |date=20 March 2025 |access-date=12 April 2026}}</ref>
